mean_reversion_inversion_diagnosis.conclusion: V1 treats absolute VWAP dislocation as reversion evidence, but Label V2 outcomes show high predicted reversion ranks lower event frequency. The sign/orientation of dislocation evidence is wrong under Label V2, especially at short horizons.

breakout_diagnosis.conclusion: Existing OHLCV features mostly encode volatility/recent drift, not reliable directional breakout pressure. Historical CVD/book features are unavailable and default neutral, removing most intended directional information.

range_continuation_diagnosis.conclusion: Low-volatility/range-like features provide some ranking, especially longer horizons, but Label V2 path-held events are so rare that V1 intercept and probability scale are badly too high.

trend_continuation_diagnosis.conclusion: Trend formula uses absolute momentum and RV, while Label V2 trend continuation depends on direction and future close exceeding an ATR threshold. Directional persistence is weak in OHLCV-only features.

label_target_interaction.mean_reversion: V1 predicts tendency from initial dislocation; Label V2 requires actual path reversion toward VWAP by a fraction. Trending dislocation breaks this assumption.
label_target_interaction.breakout_breakdown: V1 predicts directional continuation from recent return/VWAP side; Label V2 counts any path touch of frozen range boundary, producing high base rates more tied to volatility/path length than directional edge.
label_target_interaction.range_continuation: V1 predicts calm-state range persistence; Label V2 requires entire future high-low path to stay within frozen 70% range, a much stricter event.
label_target_interaction.trend_continuation: V1 predicts trend strength from abs momentum; Label V2 first defines direction then requires close beyond spot plus threshold.

simple_oracle_diagnostics.interpretation: No fitted oracle or optimized combinations were created; these are descriptive univariate upper-bound checks only.

missing_information_analysis.Open Interest / OI delta: Addresses directional breakout/breakdown and trend persistence by measuring position build/flush; cannot be reconstructed reliably later without collection.
missing_information_analysis.Funding / Basis: Helps distinguish crowded directional pressure vs spot-only drift; useful for mean-reversion vs continuation semantics.
missing_information_analysis.CVD / taker imbalance: Direct buy/sell pressure likely critical for breakout/breakdown and trend continuation orientation.
missing_information_analysis.Order-book imbalance / depth / liquidity: Can explain failed ranges, breakout barriers, and range continuation where OHLCV only sees prints after the fact.
missing_information_analysis.Liquidations: Likely explains volatility expansion, breakdown cascades, and mean-reversion inversion after forced-flow moves.
missing_information_analysis.Large/whale trade proxies: Potential directional impulse confirmation beyond aggregate volume.
missing_information_analysis.Volume profile / SMC structure: Potential support/resistance context for range continuation and breakouts.
missing_information_analysis.Options IV / skew / term structure / opt: Forward-looking expected move and tail-risk structure, directly relevant to range widths and horizon scaling.

probability_v2_design_requirements: Must be horizon-aware: separate priors/feature effects for 1H,2H,4H,8H,12H,24H.
Must be base-rate-aware: Brier should be <= empirical base-rate benchmark before claiming improvement.
Must preserve probability_v1 and range_v1 as frozen controls with new model/range version identifiers.
Must score eligibility-aware targets correctly; ineligible mean-reversion/trend rows excluded from those losses.
Must separate ranking signal from calibration; candidate ranking can be calibrated only in a later step.
Must be regime-aware or at least regime-diagnostic; fixed signs should not be assumed stable across regimes.
Ranges must target empirical coverage and report sharpness; improve actual 50/70/90 coverage without becoming uselessly wide.
Must validate on chronological splits and non-overlapping robustness before production consideration.
preserve_v1_control: Confirmed: probability_v1 and range_v1 remain frozen controls; future challengers must coexist under new versions and never overwrite this benchmark.

root_cause_matrix.evidence: AUC 0.18-0.31; high predicted probability driven by abs(vwap_zscore), but eligible Label V2 mean reversion is lower in highest dislocation/momentum regions; Brier far worse than base rate
root_cause_matrix.likely_cause: wrong feature orientation/semantic mismatch: formula assumes dislocation implies reversion, Label V2 rewards actual path reaching toward VWAP; high dislocation often accompanies trend/volatility continuation

root_cause_matrix.evidence: AUC around 0.47-0.52; mean probability ~0.31 while base rate 0.62-0.68
root_cause_matrix.likely_cause: probabilities capture recent positive momentum and VWAP side but lack directional flow/liquidity confirmation; intercept/base prior misaligned

root_cause_matrix.evidence: AUC around 0.48-0.53; mean probability ~0.30 while base rate 0.63-0.65
root_cause_matrix.likely_cause: mirror formula lacks sell-pressure/liquidation/funding context; mostly volatility/base-rate event, not direction

root_cause_matrix.evidence: base rate 4-6%, mean probability ~32%; AUC 0.55-0.58 at 8H/24H
root_cause_matrix.likely_cause: calm-state features rank some range-held cases, but intercept and Label V2 path-held rarity make absolute levels far too high

root_cause_matrix.evidence: AUC mostly 0.50-0.54; Brier worse than base rate; formula uses abs(momentum), Label V2 needs direction and threshold
root_cause_matrix.likely_cause: trend-strength proxy lacks directional persistence and flow confirmation; probability mapping ignores horizon-conditioned trend prior

root_cause_matrix.evidence: 50/70/90 actual coverage about 28-30/40-44/56-62%; empirical required multipliers exceed fixed range_v1 multipliers
root_cause_matrix.likely_cause: ATR sqrt-time widths too narrow and not regime/fat-tail aware; fixed normal-ish multipliers understate realized crypto moves

root_cause_matrix.evidence: 100% of snapshots have identical event probabilities across all six horizons
root_cause_matrix.likely_cause: horizon argument unused in event probability formulas; only ranges use horizon

Reason: horizon/base-rate/range fixes can be explored from existing data, but the largest directional failures require non-reconstructible forward feeds that should start collecting now.
